title: TAI owner child-workflow authority
objective: Allow the owner-authorized TAI exact-release command to start canonical child workflows without skipped production jobs by verifying the exact successful owner-command run, exact comment, exact main SHA and required authority job before any child production action.
boundaries: Issue 3365 and exact command /tai release current-main remain mandatory
Comment author, parent workflow actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner
Parent workflow name, repository, branch, exact SHA, exact attempt and required authority job must be verified
Child target SHA must still equal current origin/main
Canonical image revision, immutable digest, protected REG.RU controller, rollback and live acceptance remain mandatory
No direct production mutation is added to the owner-command bridge
Temporary patch workflows are branch-bound and delete themselves in the resulting implementation commit
